title: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order — part 8/8 (Sec. 18: late exposure, transfer, terminal conditioning, final matching)
coverage:
I read all of 18-late-dynamics-and-its-transfer-problem.tex (lines 1-1322) line by line. For the steps the block cites, I checked the statements in Sec. 16 (Lemma late-classes-cells, scale bounds h_i<=(log n)^.1, s_i=O(log n), Delta_i<=Ke^{s_i}, slot/pool comparison, Lemma fresh-internal-prior), Sec. 17 (definition of S_v and L_v(J), Lemma independent-pinned-list, palette cap 4K C_n^{-1}e^{-199s_i}2^{-p(v)}, eq. (24) and the uniform pair second moment, Prop initial-resampling-comparison, T_s=ceil(log^2 n)), the clock lemma in Sec. 3, b_*=n^{-1+.04/.05}, and C_n->infinity with C_n<=n.

Items and status:
- Definition of e_{w,j} and its bounds (min >= n^{-.02}; the sum times max(1,h_i) is o(1)): verified. Cluster mode uses s_i=(a/10^6)h_i. Direct and bounded modes have no internal mechanism (h_i=0, per Sec. 14), so max(1,h_i)=1 there.
- Cap (25), 8K C_n^{-1}e^{-199s_i}2^{-p_w(j)}: verified against the initial palette cap 4K... and the per-hit cost (.5-3e)^{-1}.
- Lemma late-local-transition: verified.
  - Requirement 1: the expected conflict fraction is m^{-1}+Delta||tau||_inf, at most e^4 using p_w(j)>=floor(j/2) and C_n->infinity. McDiarmid with 2/m differences gives exp(-m e^8/2), at most exp(-n^{.09}).
  - Chebyshev retention O(e^2) uses b_*<<e^4. The prefix-broadness induction holds: the product over at most n external tests is e^{-o(n)}.
  - The deletion density (1/retained mass) is <= exp(1000 l e). Eq. (27) follows. The true-hit bound follows via the deletion law, since that law is independent of the deleted sketch; Hoeffding gives exp(-8me^2), at most exp(-n^{.21}).
- Lemma late-prefix-transfer: verified at the level of each step.
  - Coset-parity invariant P(b')=P(b) and eq. late-coset-parity. Structure of V_0: either {v}, or inside the internal neighbours of b_0=v^{k0}. Only b_0 has outer word t. Each other role meets V_0 through exactly one external flip.
  - Per-class deletion count max(1,h_i), giving an O(1) path factor. Erasure, and the claim that E_keep only weakens the event, since L_w depends only on noncritical data.
  - One-block locality, both cases, including the A_k,A_j in H_i argument. Site and call counts are polylogarithmic. Block size m_*=max(1,h_i)r.
  - Reply entropy is at most n^{.4}, so a cylinder has mass >= e^{-alpha n/8} off an e^{n^.4-alpha n/8} event, and Q <= e^{alpha n/8+o(n)}pi^{tensor m}. Next-coordinate width is below alpha n/2. The survival recursion was checked.
  - Likelihood ratio R_t = prod r_H is a P_0-martingale. Stopped second moment with T*b_*^2 = n polylog * n^{-2+.08} = o(1). B_*^2 vs e^{-n^{c2}} needs only c_3<c_2. Barrier, exception and no-stop decomposition. Cauchy-Schwarz with M_i^{a'}2^{-a'd}=poly and the pair second moment from Sec. 17.
- Prop terminal-avoidance: verified.
  - Markov split on B_F. Pattern count exp(O(T_s log n)) against e^{n^delta-n^{c1}}.
  - Replay argument: unmarked decisions never read critical truths, so critical final states are fresh and independent.
  - Image-bin charge sum B_i^{-1}*B_i*D_n*n^{-PT_s/3}. LLL charges with P large. I did not re-derive the swap coupling / Lu–Székely negative-dependency step beyond its plausibility.
- Prop late-assignment: verified.
  - Minimax mask balance: the cheapest half of labels all have price <= 2/M.
  - Thresholds a_q, with Markov cost a_q/a_{q+1}=exp(-n^delta/(2r)) and a_r=e^{-n^delta/2}.
  - Clock-lemma parameter checks with n_clock=e^{n^{delta'}}: atom 2e^{g0 n}r/N, predicate scope n^{O(r)}, failure probability.
  - Column-load moment and union bound, using L_late/M_late ~ r/(nC_n) -> 0.
  - I rely on the clock lemma (Sec. 3) holding for a general large parameter in place of n; I did not audit that.
- Prop low-endpoint-kernels: verified.
  - Late-factor bookkeeping (1/Z_v<=2, 1/m^2<=4e^{O(e)}, eq. (27) integration, shared incidences O(t'j)) and the comparison chain.
  - Isolated-row bounds: row sum K/M via (24) and Lemma fresh-internal-prior; entrywise bound M^{-2}e^{.01n}.
  - Nonisolate reduction. Reverse-summation repeat cost. Final numeric inequality 4^{-k}e^{.005k}, checked by hand.
  - The calibration constants (d_i^{-.01}, d_i^{-.05}, Q_0, eps=10^{-5}) come from Sec. 16; I took them as given.
- Lemma low-two-endpoint-hall: verified.
  - Geometric averaging ratio. Tree-diagram sum 2M(K/M)^p. Two extra merges for a violating connected set of size >=3; quotient with p-1 vertices and p edges, giving 2K^{p-2}M^{-p-1}e^{.02n}.
  - L<=KM/C_n, log M = n log 2 + O(log n). Large-set exponent n log2 + eta n log(K/C_n) -> -infinity. Small-set sum.
  - Hall for the edge multigraph: each component needs #edges <= #vertices.
- Concluding paragraph: consistent with the earlier sections.
